text.name: tc_placeholder_locked
text.text: You haven't started a contracting company on this farm yet. Head to the Overview tab to create one.

text.name: tc_overview_noCompany
text.text: You haven't started a contracting company on this farm yet. Use the button below to create one.

text.name: tc_overview_currentJobsEmpty
text.text: No jobs currently allocated or in progress.

text.name: tc_actions_cannotAfford
text.text: You can't afford to start a company right now.

text.name: tc_advertising_dialog_effect
text.text: At your reputation, adverts work at %d%% of their full effect.

text.name: tc_advertising_dialog_extends
text.text: Extends your current campaign from %d to %d days left.

text.name: tc_advertising_dialog_replaces
text.text: Replaces your %s campaign (%d days left). Runs for %d days.

text.name: tc_inbox_empty
text.text: No job offers right now — check back later, or buy some advertising to bring more in.

text.name: tc_inbox_equipmentAvailable
text.text: You own the equipment needed for this job.

text.name: tc_inbox_detailHaulage
text.text: Harvest & haul: the crop goes to %s. Needs two workers - one harvesting, one hauling - or you go and haul it yourself.

text.name: tc_inbox_detailSuppliesNone
text.text: Needs %s - you have none in stock. The job will wait until you do.

text.name: tc_inbox_counterPrompt
text.text: They offered %s. Enter your counter price:

text.name: tc_inbox_counterInvalid
text.text: Enter a valid price to counter with.

text.name: tc_inbox_negotiationDeclined
text.text: They've walked away from the negotiation.

text.name: tc_inbox_negotiationCountered
text.text: They won't do %s, but they'll do %s.

text.name: tc_inbox_negotiationHolding
text.text: They won't go any higher than %s.

text.name: tc_inbox_jobRejectedInfo
text.text: Negotiation failed: they walked away from %s on Field %s.

text.name: tc_calendar_completedReport
text.text: Done by: %s. Paid %s. Time taken %s. Fuel %s (%.0f l). Quality %s, stuck resets %d.

text.name: tc_job_missedNotification
text.text: Missed deadline: %s on Field %s went uncompleted.

text.name: tc_dispatch_noVehicleReady
text.text: None of the allocated equipment can be driven by the worker (is it free, and can it do this job?).

text.name: tc_watchdog_retriedNotification
text.text: Your worker got stuck on a %s job on Field %s - reset and dispatched again.

text.name: tc_watchdog_needsAttentionNotification
text.text: Your worker is stuck on a %s job on Field %s and needs your attention.

text.name: tc_staff_rosterEmpty
text.text: No workers hired yet — switch to the Candidates view to hire your first worker.

text.name: tc_staff_candidatesEmpty
text.text: No candidates currently available to hire — check back later.

text.name: tc_sickness_offSick
text.text: %s has called in sick and can't take jobs for a few days

text.name: tc_sickness_recovered
text.text: %s is back at work after being off sick

text.name: tc_staff_hireConfirm
text.text: Hire %s for %s per period? The salary is charged at the start of every period while they're on your roster. The first period is paid now.

text.name: tc_staff_hireCannotAfford
text.text: You can't afford this candidate's first period of salary right now.

text.name: tc_staff_releaseConfirm
text.text: Release %s from your roster? This cannot be undone.

text.name: tc_vehicleLock_busy
text.text: This vehicle is out on a contract job.

text.name: tc_dispatch_noAttachPoint
text.text: Couldn't hitch %s to %s - no compatible free attachment point.

text.name: tc_allocation_needsSecondWorker
text.text: Harvest & haul needs two workers - one harvesting, one hauling. Or select Myself to go and haul it yourself.

text.name: tc_allocation_tooManyWorkers
text.text: This job only takes one worker.

text.name: tc_allocation_haulYourself
text.text: You will haul the crop yourself - deliver it to %s.

text.name: tc_allocation_playerOnly
text.text: Workers can't do this job - only you can. Select Myself.

text.name: tc_allocation_noSuppliesWarning
text.text: You have no %s in stock - the job will be on hold until you do.

text.name: tc_allocation_busyWarning
text.text: Can't allocate - busy on another job or in cooldown: %s.

text.name: tc_equipment_missing_cutter
text.text: a header or harvester that can harvest %s

text.name: tc_equipment_missing_cutterMismatch
text.text: a header for %s that fits the harvester

text.name: tc_equipment_missing_trailerHitch
text.text: a trailer that hitches to the haulage tractor

text.name: tc_haulage_deliveryComplete
text.text: Delivery done for %s - any more crop you deliver sells as normal.

text.name: tc_equipment_missing_implement_fertilize
text.text: a fertilizer spreader, sprayer or manure spreader

text.name: tc_equipment_missing_seedTank
text.text: a seed tank (front hopper) - the seeder has no hopper of its own

text.name: tc_equipment_missing_seedTankHitch
text.text: a seed tank that fits the tractor (a front hopper needs front linkage)

text.name: tc_allocation_blockedWarning
text.text: This worker isn't certified for the required equipment tier.

text.name: tc_allocation_underqualifiedWarning
text.text: This worker is under-qualified for this job - expect a reduced reward.
